## A — What it is

Visual lab / design vault, not a runtime package.

- No `package.json`; ~2.6G under [`packages/disclosure-design-references/`](packages/disclosure-design-references/)
- Nested `.git` (separate vault, not a workspace package)
- Canon: [`AGENTS.md`](packages/disclosure-design-references/AGENTS.md), [`language/visual-language.json`](packages/disclosure-design-references/language/visual-language.json), [`extractions/`](packages/disclosure-design-references/extractions/), [`prompts/`](packages/disclosure-design-references/prompts/), [`scripts/`](packages/disclosure-design-references/scripts/), local [`skills/`](packages/disclosure-design-references/skills/)
- Product: still folders + extraction md; catalogs in [`notes/`](packages/disclosure-design-references/notes/) are intermediate

## B — Should agents touch it?

**Only for design/extraction work.** Read [`AGENTS.md`](packages/disclosure-design-references/AGENTS.md) + `scripts/visual_language.py context --focus-surface …`. Do not treat as app code, CI package, or default SessionStart context.

## C — Proposal items (this package)

| Item | Verdict |
|------|---------|
| **block-new-docs** | **Change** — allow contract paths (`extractions/**`, vault `log.md`); block free-form READMEs / plans outside Folderize |
| Neon+Linear MCP | **Drop** |
| lane-router | **Drop** here (has own Visual Lanes; monorepo router would misfire) |
| dod-report / dod-auditor | **Drop** |
| git-stash hook | **Keep** (global) — disk-tight; nested `.git` makes stash especially dangerous |
| security-reviewer / security-guidance | **Drop** (low value; images + md) |
| typescript-lsp | **Drop** (Python/md/images; rare stub `component.tsx`) |
| slim SessionStart | **Keep** — exclude this tree unless design task |

## D — Package-specific note

Gate writes through Folderize + Honesty Fields ([`AGENTS.md`](packages/disclosure-design-references/AGENTS.md) §Folderize); never invent per-frame vision.

## E — Risks

1. **Context bloat / cost** if SessionStart loads vault
2. **Disk / dupe damage** (move-not-copy; ENOSPC history in AGENTS)
3. **Canon drift** if agents invent lanes/modes outside `visual-language.json`
4. **Nested `.git`** — monorepo git ops can ignore or corrupt vault state
